_readme: MACHINE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the 16 locked craft patterns and page minimums.
If this file and any prose doc disagree about pattern IDs, class names or page
minimums, THIS FILE WINS and the prose doc is the bug.

ontology.oneLine: Enlyst Framework (manifesto / living constitution) opens 18 doors; four practices under it — enlyst, enlysum, enlybiz, enlysoft — together create the Ecosystem environment, which is Enlystnow (legacy craft name: Showreel; also board-of-directors / Members face — synonym, not a parent tier).
forbidden: Ecosystem or Enlystnow depicted above the practices
Board / Members framed as a Holding above the practices
Enlystnow sold as a consumer brand on practice pages
Framework described as merely a method rather than a living constitution
Invented practice brands for unmapped board seats (e.g. Healthcare)

northStarLabel: Enlystnow Ecosystem snapshot (legacy 'showreel' folder name on disk)

inventions.name: Bento grid
inventions.description: 12-col weighted spans — feature (span-6), quarter (span-3/4), wide (span-12) hierarchy for dual-audience routing. Collapses to span-12 below 900px.

inventions.name: Atmosphere plane
inventions.description: Radial dot grid (32px) + two soft blurred orbs drifting on orbDrift (16s / 20s, alternate). Depth without particle carnival. Requires a positioned ancestor.

inventions.name: Living brand stage
inventions.description: Nav-only wordmark on practice pages; Instrument Serif weight 400 with font-synthesis:none (curly-y fix). The mark itself is STATIC — motion lives elsewhere. No duplicate logo after the header.
hardRules: Instrument Serif 400 only — never a heavier weight on the wordmark
no text-shadow, -webkit-text-stroke or filter on the wordmark

inventions.name: Chrome windows
inventions.description: Traffic-light OS terminal — faux filename bar, glass overlay, operational product theatre.

inventions.name: live-pan
inventions.description: Faux UI scroll animation inside chrome — staggered row delays, panning queue / Kanban feel. Always nested inside pattern 4.

inventions.name: Door planes
inventions.description: Weighted feature + grid using the official 18-door tokens; door-in entrance, hover glow, swatch bar scale. Never a single shared accent across doors.

inventions.name: Telemetry strip
inventions.description: Numeric proof bands — large serif numbers + mono labels as data-forward UI chrome. 3-up, collapses to 1-up below 560px.

inventions.name: Static system SVG
inventions.description: Kiln pipeline, Think→Act→Protect triad — labelled mechanics as STATIC diagrams with a mono figcaption. No animated stroke-dash spam.

inventions.name: Prose-cols
inventions.description: Dual-column narrative prose bands — cinematic readable density, not wall-of-card. Single column below 720px.

inventions.name: Himat-Hikmat dual pills
inventions.description: Courage / wisdom contrast theatre — two bordered pills with mono kicker + serif thesis. is-courage uses Framework gold; is-wisdom uses enlyst blue.

inventions.name: Spine / learning path nodes
inventions.description: Numbered connected steps with pulse — vertical connector drawn from the node, staggered spinePulse delays for steps 2–6.

inventions.name: Portrait plane
inventions.description: Full-bleed or large portrait theatre — design-native slots with a serif caption. No archive / day5 photo recycling.
hardRules: no day5 or archive photo dumps

inventions.name: Ticker
inventions.description: Live proof marquee — mono items, dot separators, infinite scroll, pause on hover. Track content must be duplicated once so the -50% translate loops seamlessly.
hardRules: duplicate the item set exactly once inside the track

inventions.name: Scroll reveal
inventions.description: IntersectionObserver entrance — opacity + translateY. Falls back to revealing everything when intensity is calm, when reduced-motion is set, or when IntersectionObserver is unavailable.

inventions.name: Section-owned palettes
inventions.description: Cream / dark / sky / theatre rhythm per band — each section owns ink, accent and mood. Minimum three distinct bands per practice page.

inventions.name: data-intensity
inventions.description: Motion tiers. REQUIRED host is the <html> element; a nested stage wrapper may override for a sub-region. prefers-reduced-motion:reduce overrides every tier.
hardRules: <html> must always carry an explicit data-intensity value
cinematic is reserved for /ecosystem/ and rare admin demos
practice pages use calm or standard

universalBaseline._note: Mandatory on EVERY public practice page, no exceptions. Page entries below list only what each page adds on top of this baseline; the resolved arrays are precomputed in pageMinimums.

pageMinimums._note: Resolved arrays = universalBaseline.required + page additions. 'required' is the audit gate; 'optional' is permitted but never sufficient.

ecosystem._note: The Enlystnow Ecosystem showcase at /ecosystem/ — the craft north star surface, not a practice page and not a brand homepage.

fonts.serif: Instrument Serif — display, H1–H3, wordmark (400 ONLY)
fonts.mono: DM Mono — micro labels, kickers, telemetry labels

supportingChrome.sectionHeaderFormula: eyebrow-rule kicker + serif H2 + lede paragraph

auditGate._note: A page passes only if every item is true. Mirrors docs/OPUS_HANDOFF.md validation checklist.
checks: html carries data-arm and an explicit data-intensity
every pattern in pageMinimums[page].required is present and rendering
at least 3 distinct section palette bands
wordmark appears in the nav only, Instrument Serif 400, font-synthesis none
no duplicate logo or wordmark after the header
door elements use per-door tokens, never one shared accent
no 'Holding', no 'mother company', no consumer-brand Enlystnow copy
no 'Showreel' in public-facing copy (legacy disk paths only)
no day5 or archive photo recycling
fonts loaded locally, no CDN font import in production
